mechanics.y_drive: GT2 6 mm belt, 20T pulley on a NEMA17 pancake stepper (fixed at the rear of the strip)
mechanics.clamp: Tr8x2 self-locking screw (NEMA17 with integrated screw) drives a presser plate; presser pushes the lid arm through 2 die springs; presser hard stop after a 5 mm spring stroke caps the force
mechanics.seal_force_basis: ESTIMATE: commercial lids 100-300 N; 96 rims x ~7.7 mm2 at >=3x the ~0.1 MPa vapour/air overpressure at 98 C needs >=220 N; design 250 N spring-defined, adjustable by spring choice

thermal_budget.status: ESTIMATES from a lumped model; measure on prototype (tests T-TC-01..08)

thinwall_block_parallel_drive_2_bridges.drive: each module on its own H-bridge (<= Vmax)

heat_sink_verdict.note: required R keeps the AVERAGE sink temperature <= 45 C during 12-cycle PCR; peaks shown per case. Fan operating point and h are estimates (+/-40 %); measure sink temperature rise at 150 W (T-TC-04).

electrical_budget.tec_string: 2 modules in series on one H-bridge, PWM 20-25 kHz with LC filter, current limit 13.0 A
electrical_budget.recommendation: peak exceeds 12 A: give TC-1 its own 24 V supply (>= 600 W, e.g. Mean Well LRS-600-24 or equivalent, 25 A), common 0 V with the machine; machine supply untouched
electrical_budget.safety_chain: block (110 C), sink (75 C) and lid (130 C) KSD301 NC bimetal cut-outs in series with the coil of a 24 V 40 A automotive relay feeding the TEC H-bridge and lid MOSFET; independent of software

open_risks.risk: Ramp rate and uniformity: predicted 67->98 heating 0.75 C/s (generic 0.45 kg block) / 1.44 C/s (thin-wall block) vs 1.5 target; 2 x 50x50 TECs cover ~60 % of the block underside, edge wells will lag; +/-0.5 C at 72 C is unproven
open_risks.mitigation: thin-wall block; measure with a 96-probe or 8-probe plate (T-TC-02); edge guard heater ring if needed

open_risks.risk: Peltier lifetime under thermal cycling and availability of a 50x50 cycling-rated module
open_risks.mitigation: buy rated modules with cycle data; 13 A current limit; ramp-rate limit in firmware; spare set

open_risks.risk: Film-free sealing: 246.7 N spring force, single-sided lid tilts ~0.25 mm across the pad (vs 0.3 mm compression): far-edge wells may evaporate
open_risks.mitigation: evaporation test 20 uL x 96 at 98 C 30 min (T-TC-05); stiffen arm (ribs) or add +X hook if > 5 % loss

open_risks.risk: Cantilevered single-rail lid: roll moment 20.4 N m on one MGN15H block; top-plate strip beside the nests is held by only 2 x M4 at x = -244 (uplift under clamp load)
open_risks.mitigation: verify catalogue moment; 2 x M4 strip screws into the deck (added at integration); measure deflection

open_risks.risk: Finger pinch: 6 mm lid stroke at 250 N; Y slide force limited only by stepper stall (~24 N)
open_risks.mitigation: hood skirts enclose the pinch zone (skirt 4 mm below plate top when clamped); IR break-beam under the hood must be clear before clamping; presser hard stop caps force; firmware stall detection; label

open_risks.risk: Condensation at 4 C hold (1 h): water on block sides runs into the TEC/foam layer and onto the top plate
open_risks.mitigation: RTV-seal TEC perimeter and foam to block; closed-cell foam strip in the 2 mm block/top-plate gap; lid kept closed with pad during hold; sink stays above dew point; drain path to a wick under the duct

open_risks.risk: Generic block 76 mm deep leaves 1 mm to the deck window front edge (y=16)
open_risks.mitigation: measure block; ask for window +3 mm

open_risks.risk: Semi-skirted plates seat on the block not on the top plate: plate top differs (software must use per-plate height)
Heat-sink R and fan operating point estimated (+/-40 %); exhaust into the under-deck space may recirculate
open_risks.mitigation: rear grille behind D1 (params change); measure sink rise at 150 W

open_risks.risk: Lid at 105 C beside nest C2 (1 mm gap): radiant heating of labware in C2
